lines: Kettle is always on. Sit by the stove when the snow gets in your boots.
Strong and steady. That is all the mill asks of anyone.
npcs.name: Bjorn

trainer.name: Bjorn
wait: Ha! Eager. I like it. But my crew get first go at you.
Three of them. Then come and warm your hands by my stove.
say: Welcome to the mill hall! Big, slow and warm, just like my team.
Nothing in Sprucevale hurries. Not the snow, not the saw, not my Pokemon.
Push as hard as you like. We will still be standing.
say2: Back for more? Good. Stamp the snow off and let us go.
lose: Ho! You knocked over a mountain. I felt that in my boots.
The Sprucevale Badge is yours. Now have some soup before you go.

lines: Dropped them all. Go on, Bjorn will be pleased with you.

trainer.name: Hedda
trainer.say: I carry two logs at a time. My team carries four. Want to see?
trainer.lose: Dropped them all. Go on, Bjorn will be pleased with you.

lines: Fine, fine. Towels are on the left.

trainer.name: Olaf
trainer.say: The hot spring is open after you beat me. Not before.
trainer.lose: Fine, fine. Towels are on the left.

lines: Timber. That was me falling over.

trainer.name: Kari
trainer.say: My Pokemon are big softies. Big softies that hit very hard!
trainer.lose: Timber. That was me falling over.

lines: Bjorn trains heavy Pokemon that shrug off hits. They wind up slowly, so make them chase you.
Keep moving, never stand toe to toe, and save your best move for when they're open.
